findings.title: One failed SendGrid cancellation aborts cancellation and deletion of all other reminders
findings.body: The whole cancellation loop is wrapped in a single try/catch and the Prisma deletes are only executed with Promise.all after the loop finishes. If client.request fails for any reminder (e.g. a null/already-sent/already-cancelled referenceId), the loop aborts, the already-collected workflowRemindersToDelete are never executed, and no later reminders in remindersToCancel are cancelled at SendGrid. Those emails can still be sent, and the poison reminder will block the batch again on every subsequent cron run.

findings.title: immediateDelete cancels at SendGrid but leaves the reminder row active in the database
findings.body: When immediateDelete is true the function POSTs the SendGrid cancel and returns without deleting the WorkflowReminder row or setting cancelled=true. Callers such as the reschedule path in handleNewBooking therefore leave the old reminder scheduled:true/cancelled unset, so the new deferred cron mechanism in scheduleEmailReminders (which only acts on cancelled=true rows) will never retry it. If that single immediate SendGrid cancel fails or hits the 100 pending-cancellations limit described in the PR, the old reminder email is still sent for the rescheduled booking.

findings.title: Reminder cancellations are fired without await before the handler completes
findings.body: deleteScheduledEmailReminder and deleteScheduledSMSReminder are async (they update/delete the WorkflowReminder row and, for SMS, call Twilio), but they are invoked inside forEach callbacks whose promises are discarded and are not included in the subsequent Promise.all. The handler can return (and in a serverless environment the invocation can be frozen/terminated) before cancelled=true is persisted, so the cron job that now depends on that flag may never see the cancellation and the scheduled email is sent for the cancelled booking. The same un-awaited pattern is used for the new cancellation calls in handleNewBooking and the bookings/workflows tRPC routers.

findings.title: Cancellation query does not restrict to scheduled email reminders with a referenceId
findings.body: remindersToCancel matches any WorkflowReminder with cancelled=true and scheduledDate <= now+1h, with no method=EMAIL, scheduled=true, or referenceId-not-null filter. Any cancelled row without a SendGrid batch id (or a non-email row) is passed to SendGrid as batch_id: null, which will error; combined with the single try/catch around the loop this prevents cancellation/deletion of all valid reminders in the same run.
